external_sources.title: Trading volume and liquidity provision in cryptocurrency markets
external_sources.claim: Short-term crypto reversal/liquidity-provision returns are concentrated in lower-activity, smaller, more volatile and less-liquid pairs; lagged return interacted with trading volume contains predictive information.

external_sources.title: Cryptocurrency Return Reversals
external_sources.claim: Return reversals exist in crypto but are strongest among smaller-cap and less-liquid assets, supporting conditional rather than unconditional contrarian exposure.

external_sources.title: Intraday Return Predictability in the Cryptocurrency Markets: Momentum, Reversal, or Both
external_sources.claim: Bitcoin intraday momentum versus reversal changes with large jumps, liquidity, and event regimes, so a range fade should explicitly no-trade continuation-prone states.

external_sources.title: Reversals and the Returns to Liquidity Provision
external_sources.claim: Volatility and turnover change both the speed and persistence of short-run reversals, providing a direct basis for preregistered reversal-timescale conditioning.

external_sources.title: Explainable Patterns in Cryptocurrency Microstructure
external_sources.claim: Order-flow imbalance, spread and adverse-selection features have stable predictive structure across crypto assets, and tradability must be assessed after conservative taker costs.
